summary: Assess BESS business models, procurement risks, and contract KPIs. Explore practical training for energy-sector decision-makers.
lede: Utility-scale battery storage procurement training helps utility and finance teams assess projects and shape procurement decisions. It is for utility and public-agency procurement leads, developers and infrastructure finance teams, covering use-case and investment assessment, comparison of ownership and service models, and tender evaluation criteria. Participants also map delivery and operating risks and define contract-performance measures through practical exercises in bid scoring and KPI reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who assess, procure, finance, regulate, develop, or oversee utility-scale battery storage projects and services.
prerequisites: Experience in power-sector planning, procurement, project development, infrastructure finance, regulation, or energy advising is useful. No battery engineering or coding background is required. Bring familiarity with your organization’s procurement or investment decision process where available.
